verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS accounting product with web, mobile and desktop apps, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls; the items address the API, OAuth, MCP, AI features and pricing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
